┌─ Help: Quest chains and fighting ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Quest chains                                                                 │
│   A new character is offered First Steps in Thornwick: talk to the Watch     │
│   greeter in Hawthorn Square, talk to your class trainer, take a contract    │
│   from the board, then go out through the east gate. It pays a small reward  │
│   at the end.                                                                │
│   It is optional. Nothing walks you anywhere and nothing reminds you; the    │
│   Quest chain panel shows the step you are on, and the log tells you when    │
│   one is done.                                                               │
│   Ctrl+K (or /quest) shows the chain. X there (or /dismiss) gives it up for  │
│   good, after one question: a dismissed chain is never offered again.        │
│                                                                              │
│ Fighting                                                                     │
│   Tab chooses a target (Esc clears it). F or Space turns auto-attack on or   │
│   off. 1-8 use the abilities in your slots on your target.                   │
│   With no target, an attack or an ability goes to whatever is attacking you, │
│   the nearest first; the status line names the one picked. If nothing is     │
│   attacking you it is refused: Tab to a target first.                        │
│   A fight stops your walk: attacking, using an ability on an enemy, or       │
│   something attacking you. The log says "Your walk stopped"; press a move    │
│ Page 3 of 7  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 HP 115/120 | Target: Shell Rat 12/20
